segments.name: Sale of crude oil
segments.description: Trades crude oil for customers across Southeast Asia, East Asia and the Middle East.
segments.evidence: Crude oil trading represents a core aspect of our business as it accounts for a significant portion of our revenue.

segments.name: Sale of oil-based products
segments.description: Trades oil-based products such as naphtha, motor gasoline and asphalt for customers across Southeast Asia, East Asia and the Middle East.
segments.evidence: We are principally engaged in the trading of oil related products, which can be broadly categorized into (i) crude oil and (ii) oil-based products such as naphtha, motor gasoline, gas oil, fuel oil, asphalt, base oil and other petrochemicals.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the company for crude oil and oil-based products it trades, often with flexible financing and delivery options.
revenueModel.evidence: In addition, our financing capabilities allow us to extend credit terms to our customers while satisfying the immediate payment terms required by our suppliers.
